# Thunderbird Calendar create/edit attribute-driven source loader

D324288 clarified container selection in `show()`, camel-cased three new route tests, and restored `event.getAttendees().length > 0`; `getAttendees()` guarantees an array, so the explicit expression is preferred. Accept required Prettier output, then rerun focused ESLint and `git diff --check`; runtime Calendar browser coverage remained unrun. [Task 8]
